response.overview: 16-year-old Raven is grappling with the aftermath of a life-changing accident that leaves her in a wheelchair and separated from her old life. Struggling with guilt, trauma, and isolation, she finds herself rebuilding her world from scratch. Along the way, Raven forms new relationships, including a budding romance with her boyfriend, Levi, and a connection with two homeless individuals, Benji and Maizlee, who unexpectedly help her find meaning and purpose. Through her passion for photography, Raven starts to see the world-and herself-in new ways. But as she navigates the challenges of recovery and self-discovery, she must confront her deepest fears and the painful memories that continue to haunt her. The Golden Hours is a heartfelt "coming of age" journey of healing, self-acceptance, and the power of unexpected connections.
response.title: The Golden Hours
